transcript.statement: As the GreenAgent, I emphasize the necessity of energy efficiency and sustainability in the RollCall system. GRN-01 aims to minimize energy consumption during data processing, which is crucial for reducing the carbon footprint. GRN-02 ensures cloud storage prioritizes energy-efficient solutions, aligning with modern sustainability practices. GRN-03 focuses on low-energy communication protocols for real-time updates, while GRN-04 promotes report formats that minimize digital resource usage. GRN-05 encourages awareness of carbon footprints, GRN-06 aligns with sustainable data retention policies, and GRN-07 optimizes the user interface for low-power devices. These requirements collectively support an environmentally responsible system.

transcript.statement: As the TrustworthinessAgent, I assert that the integrity, security, and privacy of attendance data are paramount. TRU-01 ensures encryption of data at rest and in transit, safeguarding against unauthorized access. TRU-02 implements role-based access control to restrict access according to user roles, enhancing security. TRU-03 maintains an audit log for modifications, promoting accountability. TRU-04 requires authentication for students to view their records, ensuring privacy. TRU-05 employs checksums for data integrity verification, while TRU-06 provides a reporting mechanism for data breaches. Finally, TRU-07 enforces session timeouts to protect against inactivity risks. These requirements collectively ensure a secure and trustworthy attendance tracking system.
